title: Billing Operations Standard: Early Termination Fee Calculation for Small Business Electricity Supply
content:
## 1. Termination date and remaining months

1.1 The standard early termination fee on a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement measures the termination from the date the business confirmed the cancellation (the drop requested date on the agreement record).

1.2 The remaining months are twelve times the difference in years plus the difference in months between the termination date and the contract end date, plus one when the day of the month of the contract end date is later than the day of the month of the termination date; the remaining months are never fewer than zero.

## 2. Remaining kWh

2.1 The standard monthly usage of the site is the average kWh per energy line over the agreement's energy lines posted in the 12 months before the handling date, that is their kWh added up and divided by the number of those lines; a line falls in those 12 months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posted date from the handling date.

2.2 The remaining kWh are the monthly usage times the remaining months, rounded half up to a whole kWh.

## 3. Fee by method

3.1 Under the per-remaining-kWh method the standard fee is the remaining kWh times the plan's damages rate per kWh, rounded half up to the cent, but not less than the plan's minimum fee.

3.2 Under the flat method the fee is the plan's flat fee. Under the none method no fee applies.

3.3 Under the per-remaining-kWh method the fee is put together in this order: first the remaining kWh, the monthly usage times the remaining months rounded half up to a whole kWh, are multiplied by the damages rate and rounded half up to the cent; then the larger of that amount and the minimum fee is taken; then any amount deducted from the fee is taken from that larger amount, and the result is the fee.

## 4. No fee

No fee applies when the termination date falls within the plan's free window of calendar days before the contract end date, equality counting as inside; or within the plan's automatic-renewal free days after the start of an automatically renewed term (its plan change date); or within the plan's rescission window days after the utility's confirmation date; or when the plan waives the fee on an upgrade to a commercial and industrial contract and the cancellation was made for that upgrade with a Beacon Ridge commercial and industrial contract on the same site in pending or active status.

## 5. Worked examples (hypothetical plan figures: damages rate 0.0130 USD per kWh, minimum fee 160.00 USD)

| Item | Example A | Example B |
|---|---|---|
| Cancellation confirmed | 10 March 2026 | 10 March 2026 |
| Contract end date | 31 December 2026 | 31 December 2026 |
| Remaining months | 9, plus one because 31 is later than 10: 10 | 10 |
| Energy lines in the 12 months | 12 lines, 102000 kWh | 12 lines, 13200 kWh |
| Monthly usage | 8500 kWh | 1100 kWh |
| Remaining kWh | 85000 | 11000 |
| Remaining kWh times damages rate | 1105.00 USD | 143.00 USD |
| Larger of that and the minimum fee | 1105.00 USD | 160.00 USD |
| Fee | 1105.00 USD | 160.00 USD |

A termination date of 5 December 2026 on the same agreement with a 30-day free window falls 26 days before the contract end date, inside the window, and no fee applies.
